parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
By reference to the definition of gravitational potential, explain why gravitational potential is a
negative quantity.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
Use data from Fig. 1.2 to calculate the change in kinetic energy of the rock when it
moves from the point where x = $0.1 \times 10^{12}\,\mathrm{m}$ to the point where x = $1.2 \times 10^{12}\,\mathrm{m}$.
State whether this change is an increase or a decrease.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
At a point where $x = 0.1 \times 10^{12}\,\mathrm{m}$, the speed of the rock is $v$.
Determine the minimum speed $v$ such that the rock reaches the point where $x = 1.2 \times 10^{12}\,\mathrm{m}$.
$\text{minimum speed} = \text{................................................... }\mathrm{m\,s^{-1}}$
